name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
November 13, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Michael Carr, All Saints Episcopal Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Certificate of Appreciation to Assistant City Attorney Martin "Pete" Grover.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD/JPFA)
C3.
Treasurer’s Cash Report for Month Ending September 30, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Appointment of Youth Commissioners and Outside Agency Representative (CC)
C5.
Amendment to Regional Communications System Agreement (CC)
C6.
Proposition 84 Urban Greening Grant Award (CC)
C7.
State FY 2011 Homeland Security Program Grant Award (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , accepting grant funds of $72,188 in FY 2011 State Homeland Security Program funding and amending the FY 2012/13 Operating Budget; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the FY 2011 State Homeland Security Program Grant Assurances.
C8.
Federal FY 2011 Assistance to Firefighters Grant Award (CC)
C9.
CIP No. 8165 Age and Condition Related Sewer Rehabilitation - Award of Contract (CC)
C10.
Renewal of Cityworks Annual Licensing Agreements (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Recreation & Community Services Facility Rental & Program Fees and Facility Rental Policies & Procedures (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the Recreation & Community Services Facility Rental & Program Fees; and;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the Recreation & Community Services Facility Rental Policies & Procedures.
D2.
Fiscal Year 2012/13 First Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive and file the report;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2012/13.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
N. Melrose Apartments - Zephyr Partners (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to consider an application for a General Plan Amendment, Specific Plan Amendment, Zone Change, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Parcel Map for 407 apartment units at 1401 N. Melrose Drive;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for the N. Melrose Apartment Project;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a General Plan Amendment from Industrial General (IG) to Mixed Use (MU) on property at 1401 N. Melrose Drive;
4.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving an Amendment to Specific Plan No. 8 and a Zone Change from Specific Plan No. 8 (SP-08) to Mixed Use, 30 Units Per Acre (M-U(30)) on Property at 1401 N. Melrose Drive;" and (Recommendation continued on following page)
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Site Development Plan and Tentative Parcel Map for 407 apartment units and associated improvements at 1401 N. Melrose Drive.
PH2.
Amended and Restated Acquisition Disposition and Development Agreement (CC/SA)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
